references.title: Textron Marine & Land Systems
references.note: No Wikidata item or free article covers Cadillac Gage as it existed when it built the Stoner 63; Q2932698 is the successor company formed by its 1994 merger with Textron Marine, a distinct legal entity, so wikidataId is left out here rather than recording a wrong join. This article names Cadillac Gage/Textron Marine as its predecessor.
